$comment: Who may read and write each model of prisma/schema/labour.prisma (rules: src/ownership.ts; roles: src/roles.ts). Floor work (W2b schema wave 7/7, B-W2b-12): the office (factory_runtime) keeps the codes, closes line days, answers disputes, plans the dispatch and reviews scan findings through command(); the floor tablets (factory_floor_runtime, their own site) record team members, ticked steps, off-standard time, disputes, coupons and crews, and the team leader on the floor approves, edits and reassigns. The partner reads nothing here (no portal or link sees floor work); nothing here has a money column. A person is named only on the rows of their own records (the person columns are listed in each entry's about, for the privacy export and erase); their figures are read only through the API's legal gate (Statuto art. 4 c.1, GATE-LABOUR; Owner answer F2: never a list, filter, group or total by person). OperationScanMember, OperationChecklistResult and LabourEdit are append-only (no update or delete for anyone; their triggers). After a change run `npm run policies -w @nexus/factory-db -- <folder>`.

OperationScanMember.about: The members of a team operation: the tablet (or the office, entering for the lead) inserts them with the scan; both read them. Never changed or removed. Person column: workerId (purpose PERFORMANCE).

OperationChecklistResult.about: The steps ticked inside an operation: the tablet inserts them; both read them (Finish waits for the required ones). Never changed or removed. Person column: workerId (purpose PERFORMANCE; null where the site records stations).

OffStandardCode.about: The company's off-standard and indirect codes with their pay rules: the office keeps them (words, icon, colour, order, active; a code never changes, an unused one is set inactive); every floor device reads them for its tiles (nothing personal, no amount: no site key). Never deleted.

OffStandardEntry.about: Off-standard and indirect time: the tablet starts and ends a block (and the team leader on the floor approves or edits it); the office types, approves, rejects and edits blocks. Never deleted (rejected instead). Person columns: workerId, approvedById, rejectedById (purpose PERFORMANCE; workerId null where the site records stations).

LabourDay.about: Each line's day and its close: the office closes and reopens it (Labour & corrections); the floor reads it (a closed day takes no more floor changes: the off-standard trigger reads it as the role that fires it). No person column. Never deleted.

LabourEdit.about: The append-only record of every edit of a labour record (before, after, who, why): written in the command that edits, by the office or the team leader on the floor; both read it (the off-standard trigger reads it as the role that fires it). Never changed or removed. Person column: workerId (whose record; purpose PERFORMANCE).

LabourDispute.about: A worker's dispute of their own record: raised on the floor (My day) or in the office, withdrawn by the worker, answered by the team leader or HR. Never deleted. Person columns: workerId, answeredById (purpose PERFORMANCE; GDPR art. 15).

DispatchAssignment.about: The day's dispatch: the office plans and rearranges it (a plan, not a ledger: removed with Undo; every move is in the audit log); the floor reads it (My work, the line view) and the team leader reassigns there. Person columns: workerId, overrideById.

BundleCoupon.about: A coupon per bundle and operation (sites that scan coupons): printed in the office or on the floor, voided with a reason and replaced there. No person column. Never deleted.

ScanPatternFinding.about: Scan-pattern findings about bundles: the finding job (system scope) writes them, the office reviews them. The floor reads none. No person column (about a bundle, never a person). Never deleted.

CrewSession.about: Crew mode on one station tablet: the tablet opens and ends its crew; the office reads it and ends it when it revokes the device. No person column (its members are). Never deleted.

CrewMember.about: The workers of a crew: the tablet adds them (badge scan), switches the active one and lets them leave; the office reads them and ends them with a revoke or a deactivation. Never deleted. Person column: workerId (who worked where, when: traceability, as FloorSession).
